== Title ==
<span lang="ja">サンドクローラー：搬入ベイ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">自分のサンドクローラーに配備する。ここではジャワは全員没収値＋2となる。ここは"夜間状態"である。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分のキャラクターがここに出入りするにはそれぞれ1フォースが必要。ここは"夜間状態"である。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Sandcrawler: Loading Bay]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese prints one asterisk (unique). English uniqueness is Restricted (three dots). Title uses 搬入ベイ. Light Jawa text is 全員没収値＋2となる, longer than Junkheap. Zero Force icons; Interior and Vehicle Site icons.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-sandcrawlerloadingbay-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Sandcrawler: Loading Bay]].</ref>
